name: Ashdoth Pisgah
overview: Ashdoth Pisgah, referred to as the springs or hill of Pisgah, marks a significant geographical boundary east of the Jordan River, extending from the plain near Chinnereth to the salt sea. Scripture highlights the water courses flowing from Mount Pisgah, emphasizing its role in defining the extent of the land given to Israel. These references in Deuteronomy and Joshua underscore the importance of Ashdoth Pisgah as a landmark in the Promised Land, illustrating God's provision and faithful fulfillment of His promise to His people.
